title: La conquista de México
goal: Read how Tenochtitlan actually fell: an alliance with the Mexica's own enemies, a smallpox epidemic that killed an emperor, and a two-year campaign rather than an overnight collapse.

items: Explain what Cortés actually did with his ships, and correct the popular myth about it.
Explain why the alliance with Tlaxcala was decisive.
Describe what happened during the Noche Triste.
Explain what role smallpox played in the fall of Tenochtitlan.
Use passive voice to narrate a military campaign.
